findings.finding: Instantaneous cubic velocity and pressure moments fail because differentiating the velocity term produces an uncontrolled |u||p|^2 pairing and differentiating the pressure moment requires nonlocal p_t; a smooth shear defeats universal damping.

The windowed essential-supremum functional assigns a 1/ell penalty to ordinary smooth local energy, diverges for constants as ell tends to zero, and its sliding-window edge derivative restores pressure flux.

findings.finding: The time-averaged enstrophy/higher-derivative candidate is not homogeneous as proposed; corrected powers expose localized vortex stretching and an unclosed higher derivative/pressure hierarchy, while fixed-time transfer remains absent.
